description: Live DNS lookup of a name against the zone's authoritative nameservers and three public resolvers, side by side. Use after DNS changes to verify and check propagation.

name.description: Name to look up, e.g. www.example.fi or example.fi.

servers.description: Where to ask: authoritative (the zone's own nameservers) and public (large public resolvers). Default both.

name: oma_dns_lookup
title: DNS lookup
